## Context / immutable basis
At `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`, the 18 Python modules below contain 40 confirmed editable prose blocks (31 true leading docstrings, 9 maximal full-line comment regions; 5,107 before-words). All 18 blobs are byte-identical to the legacy `9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192` audit and to `origin/main@6e3c3571dd5b4f82a0faf55ac4b3f3a44401b708`; the old ranges were only imprecise. The base SHA and stable IDs are immutable before-citations; line numbers are not scope.

## Editing boundary
Edit only the path-qualified stable IDs below plus adjacent blank-line normalization. `D:<owner>` means the leading `Expr(Constant(str))` of that exact module/class/function owner. `C:<scope>:before:<anchor>` means one maximal full-line comment region in the innermost AST scope, anchored to the next unchanged code prefix. The full ID is `<path>#<D-or-C-ID>`.

For every owned path, retain immutable-before and final blobs and parse both with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`. Remove only allowlisted leading docstrings on comparison copies, normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`, and require the remaining ASTs equal. Tokenization must reject changed inline or non-allowlisted comments. Directive text and attachment are separately exact.

## Protected material and contracts
Keep every unlisted docstring/comment, all inline comments, runtime strings, regexes, prompts, assertions, subprocess arguments, fixtures/test data, and 7 directive-bearing physical lines exact. No selected target is consumed through `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, doctest, or pydoc.

Preserve canonical hashing; caplog propagation/level detection; CAS sleep→refetch+jitter; caused-by provenance/dedup; failure typing and epic screening; generator/gate normalization; child-env isolation; child-process signal oracles; CI trigger/actionlint/provider-matrix policy. Pytest directly collects every module; the owned child-oracle module also loads the owned actionlint-install module, and the focused run includes the real CAS-contention companion.

## Independent review receipt
A reviewer who did not author the patch posts exactly 40 leaf-linked TSV PASS rows:
`stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.

Before citations are `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84:<path>#<stable-id>`; final citations use the full final commit SHA. Every row has `after_words < before_words` and `directives_exact=PASS`, `semantic-preservation=PASS`, and `bloat-removal=PASS`. Missing, duplicate, extra, author-reviewed, or non-PASS rows block closure.
